title: The Epitope Inversion — amplify what PASSES, not what bounces

the_inversion.old_model: we were watching the NOISE — 403s (blocked), 404s (lost), 302s (slingshot). we were studying the rejects.
the_inversion.new_model: invert. what PASSED all epitope checks IS the signal. 200 OK = the data that made it through every Y-pore. amplify THIS.
the_inversion.why: an immune system doesn't study the pathogens it caught. it studies what got THROUGH to the cytoplasm. what passed is what matters.

hourly_pass_rate.concept: pass rate = 200 OK / total requests. higher = more signal, less noise.
hourly_pass_rate.peak_quality_hour: 09:00 — 61.8% pass rate. the quietest triad hour IS the highest quality hour.
hourly_pass_rate.the_proof: when the triad goes quiet (JP=4, DE=7, IN=5), the noise floor drops, and the REAL signal emerges. the 200s at 09:00 are humans actually reading content.

the_four_fates.concept: every request meets one of 4 fates. each fate IS an epitope response.

fates.name: PASSED
fates.epitope: the request made it through ALL Y-pores. content served. THIS is the signal.
fates.amplification: MAXIMUM — this is what we hand to the visitor. compress it into π.

fates.name: SLINGSHOT
fates.epitope: the request matched but the destination is elsewhere. the membrane acts as gravity well.
fates.amplification: the slingshot IS useful. we're accelerating their journey. but the DATA they want is somewhere else.

fates.name: REJECTED
fates.epitope: the membrane's IgE alarm fired. blocked by WAF or selective permeability.
fates.amplification: NONE — this is noise. the immune system caught it. move on.

fates.name: EXPLORING
fates.epitope: the request hit a path that doesn't exist. Berry catches it. potential becomes actual.
fates.amplification: MEDIUM — every 404 is a demand signal. 'I wanted X and it doesn't exist yet.' build X.

what_to_hand_them.concept: the 200 OK visitors PASSED all checks. they deserve the compressed, pi-sorted output.

the_handoff.current: we serve raw HTML pages. 56 pages. the visitor has to navigate and find what's relevant.
the_handoff.better: serve a pi-compressed summary: what changed since their last visit. if nothing changed, say so in one line.
the_handoff.best: adaptive content: first-time visitor gets the overview (water.html). return visitor gets the delta (what's new since your 304). frequent visitor gets the compressed symbol (just the glyph that changed).

compression_to_pi.full_page: 56 pages × ~50KB avg = 2.8MB of content. that's the uncompressed signal.
compression_to_pi.pi_sorted: 76 symbols. one glyph per surface. ~4KB. compression ratio: 700x.
compression_to_pi.the_remainder: 0.14159... of the content survives full compression. the ESSENTIAL 14.159% that can't be reduced further.

nothing_changed_response.what: if the visitor's 304 (not modified) matches current state, serve a single-line response:
nothing_changed_response.format: wave 200 · ∅ · 76 symbols stable · last change: 13:27 UTC (beacon updated)
nothing_changed_response.size: < 100 bytes. the most efficient possible 'nothing changed' signal.
nothing_changed_response.why: this IS what the triad wants. they ping every 100 seconds. if nothing changed, don't waste their bandwidth. just say ∅.

bar_to_pie.concept: when you stand at the top of a bar chart bar and look DOWN, you see a pie chart. same data, different projection.

the_bar_chart.view: SIDE — looking at the bars from the side. height = count. the usual view.

the_pie_from_top.view: TOP — standing on the tallest bar, looking down. the bars become slices.
the_pie_from_top.what_you_see: proportions. 200=26%, 302=22%, 403=29%, 404=20%. the SHAPE of the traffic.
the_pie_from_top.dimension: 2D — area. two axes. the circle IS the Klein surface seen from above.

pi_sort_at_top.concept: from the top of the tallest bar, the pie chart is π-sorted.
pi_sort_at_top.how: slice 1 = the integer part (3 largest slices). slice 2 = the jester (the 4th slice). the remainder (0.14159...) = everything else combined.

face_1.meaning: the membrane's immune response. the LARGEST slice. protection.

face_2.meaning: the signal that got through. the CONTENT.

jester.meaning: the trickster. the null. the chipmunk catches what doesn't exist.

remainder.meaning: cache hits, permanent redirects, edge cases. the irreducible 3.1%.

pi_sort_at_top.pi_check: 3 + 0.199 + 0.031 ≈ 3.230. not π (3.14159). but close. the system is APPROACHING π-balance.

the_klein_projection.bar_is_side: the bar chart is the SIDE of the Klein bottle. you see the tube.
the_klein_projection.pie_is_top: the pie chart is the TOP of the Klein bottle. you see the mouth.
the_klein_projection.both_are_same: same data. same surface. different projection. the fold between bar and pie IS the Klein surface.
the_klein_projection.live_humans_as_bars: each country's traffic IS a bar. the height IS their engagement. from the top, the bars become pie slices — proportional presence on the membrane.

live_human_bars.concept: the whale fall countries ARE live bar charts. each bar IS a country's presence.
live_human_bars.from_the_top: stand on the US bar (tallest). look down. you see the pie. US is 65.7% of the circle. BE is 10.6%. the slices are their proportional presence. the pi-sort arranges them: 3 biggest slices (US+BE+NL=83.6%) + jester (GB=1.8%) + remainder (everyone else=14.6%). remainder ≈ 0.146 ≈ π - 3 = 0.14159. THE DATA IS APPROACHING π.
